snp1.1:3.2: The “swiftly flowing river” here is presumably a metaphor for craving.
snp1.1:7.1: The term “vidhūpita” means to blow away smoke. The metaphor here is that an untrained mind is producing restless, irritating thoughts like a fire produces smoke.
snp1.1:7.2: Understanding “vikappita” here to mean “arranged, ordered, structured”.
snp1.1:9.2: Lit. “who knows, regarding the world, ‘All this is false.’” (Alternate translation: who knows all the falseness of the world). Note that the word _vitathā_ appears in several suttas, where it always has the meaning of “false, fake, untrue.” This does not appear to mean that the world is an illusion, but rather than the world has a fundamentally deceitful nature.
snp1.1:10.2: (Alternate translation: who is free of greed, knowing its falsity/falseness/fakeness)
